subject: A problem in gene annotation (CpG in gene body but not the nearest gene)

messages.author: f6a97d8c082d5380
messages.subject: A problem in gene annotation (CpG in gene body but not the nearest gene)
parts:
Dear sir/madam,
When I get the differentially methylated CpG, I often annotated the site using getAssociationWithTSS. But I found a CpG site may be annotated to one gene with the nearest distance to TSS, while the CpG site may within the gene body of another gene which does not have the nearest distance to TSS. But I think in this situation, the gene body should be considered first, doesn't it? How to set the gene body first?

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] A problem in gene annotation (CpG in gene body but not the nearest gene)
parts:
you can try to annotate using GenomicRanges functions, every methyKit object is coercible to GRanges, and readTranscriptFeatures() produces a GRangesList. Here is some intro on GRanges functionality: 
http://compgenomr.github.io/book/genomic-intervals-and-r.html#operations-on-genomic-intervals-with-genomicranges-package
